description: About Bosky Holland Cheese wares: We love cheese! Since 1896, here at Bosky, it’s been our mission to spread the love of cheese to everyone everywhere. Our innovative family-owned company started as a blacksmith making tools for the cheese farmers in Holland, and now we are the world’s only specialist in Cheese wares: cheese tools and accessories. In short: we sell everything you need to enjoy cheese except the cheese itself!
